695-  # accept/reject -- that stays in bootstrap_confirm_claim/2 alongside the other
696-  # discovered-claim validations, so all rejection reasons are visible in one place.

714-  # fix-bootstrap-admin-session-identity (AC2): decode the full verified claims map stashed
715-  # by bootstrap_callback/2 under "bootstrap_full_claims" (Jason-encoded, NOT the flattened
716-  # "bootstrap_claims" list — that one is dot-path-flattened for the claim-picker UI and is
717-  # not usable as input to Nebu.Matrix.UserId.from_claims/2's flat-key lookups).
718-  #
719-  # A legacy in-flight bootstrap (started before this fix shipped) has no
720-  # "bootstrap_full_claims" key at all — falls back to reconstructing a flat claims map
721-  # from "bootstrap_claims" (the dot-path-flattened discovered-claims list) plus
722-  # "bootstrap_sub"/"bootstrap_email", which is exactly what every prior bootstrap_callback/2
723-  # run already stashed. Only BARE (non-dot-path) keys are restored — a nested claim (e.g.
724-  # "realm_access.roles") cannot be losslessly reconstructed from its flattened form, but
725-  # `Nebu.Matrix.UserId.from_claims/2` only ever does flat top-level lookups
726-  # (configured claim / preferred_username / name / sub), so this is sufficient for its
727-  # purposes. Repeated bare keys (multi-valued claims, e.g. "groups") are folded into a list.
